senses.gloss: ch. (contr. of תער, v. עוּר) to be awake.—V. תִּיר.

units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 117b:3">B. Kam. 117ᵇ</cite> <he>תַּיְּירֵיה אוקמיה</he> he waked him up (from the dead) and made him to stand (live).—[<cite ref="Gittin 69b:8">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>וניתייריה</he>, read: <he>וניתריה</he>, v. <cite ref="V00744"><he>תְּרֵי</he> II</cite>.]
